title: String Concatenation
description: Combine first and last names into a full name using string concatenation.

data.text: Write a query to display each employee's full name as 'FirstName LastName'.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    EmployeeID,
    FirstName + ' ' + LastName AS FullName,
    Department
FROM Employees
ORDER BY FullName;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: In SQL Server, use the + operator for string concatenation. CONCAT() is also available and handles NULL values gracefully — CONCAT(NULL, 'text') returns 'text', while NULL + 'text' returns NULL. Use CONCAT for safer concatenation.
